title: Simple Rename Command
description: A dead simple command to rename items to any text component.
body:
A dead simple command to rename items to any text component.

## Usage
`/renameitem <text component>` - Renames your held item to the provided text component.

## Support

If you find a bug, file an [issue](https://codeberg.org/girlonthenet/simple-rename-command/issues) or join the [Discord](https://discord.gg/A2FEXREAtQ).
